BOOK ONE · LESSON 091

Poor Ian!

可怜的伊恩！

A dialogue lesson on the future tense with 'shall/will' and 'be going to'. Three neighbours (Catherine, Jenny, and Linda) discuss Ian, who has just sold his house and is moving tomorrow afternoon. Jenny has always known Ian as a good neighbour and will see him today to give him their regards. The twist: Ian didn't want to leave, but his wife did! New vocabulary includes still, move, miss, neighbour, person, people, and poor. Workbook practice covers completing the dialogue (fill in missing words) and sorting nouns by plural pronunciation. Grammar exercises practise replacing 'am/is/are going to' with 'shall/will' and completing dialogues using the cues given.

01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen then answer this question. Who wanted to sell the house?
听录音，然后回答问题。谁想卖房？

Listen to the recording and answer the question: Who wanted to sell the house?

  1. 1

    CATHERINE

    Has Ian sold his house yet?

    凯瑟琳：伊恩已把他的房子卖掉了吗？

  2. 2

    JENNY

    Yes, he has.
    He sold it last week.

    詹尼：是的，卖掉了。他上星期卖掉的。

  3. 3

    CATHERINE

    Has he moved to his new house yet?

    凯瑟琳：他已经迁进新居了吗？

  4. 4

    JENNY

    No, not yet.
    He's still here.
    He's going to move tomorrow.

    詹尼：不，还没有。他仍在这里。他打算明天搬家。

  5. 5

    CATHERINE

    When? Tomorrow morning?

    凯瑟琳：什么时候？明天上午吗？

  6. 6

    JENNY

    No. Tomorrow afternoon.
    I'll miss him.
    He has always been a good neighbour.

    詹尼：不，明天下午。我会想念他的。他一直是把好邻居。

  7. 7

    LINDA

    He's a very nice person.
    We'll all miss him.

    琳达：他是个非常好的人，我们大家都会想念他的。

  8. 8

    CATHERINE

    When will the new people move into this house?

    凯瑟琳：新住户什么时候搬进这所房子？

  9. 9

    JENNY

    I think that they'll move in
    the day after tomorrow.

    詹尼：我想他们将在后天搬进来吧。

  10. 10

    LINDA

    Will you see Ian today, Jenny?

    琳达：詹尼，您今天会见到伊恩吗？

  11. 11

    JENNY

    Yes, I will.

    詹尼：是的，我会见到他。

  12. 12

    LINDA

    Please give him my regards.

    琳达：请代我问候他。

  13. 13

    CATHERINE

    Poor Ian!
    He didn't want to leave this house.

    凯瑟琳：可怜的伊恩！他本不想离开这幢房子。

  14. 14

    JENNY

    No, he didn't want to leave,
    but his wife did!

    詹尼：是啊，他是不想离开，可是他妻子要离开。

v. 搬家

v. 想念，思念
neighbour /ˈneɪbə(r)/
n. 邻居

Notes on the text 课文注释

No, not yet

No, not yet. 不，还没有。
这是简略回答，完整的回答是 He hasn't moved to his new house yet.

He's a very nice person

He's a very nice person. 他是一个非常 好的人。person 是指人。当需要表示复数形式时，往往用 people 这个词。如后面的一句话 When will the new people move into this house?

Please give him my regards

Please give him my regards. 请代我问候他。

No, he didn't want to leave ...

No, he didn't want to leave ... 是对上一句话的证实。由于上一句话中用了否定形式，因此，在证实时句中的动词不可模仿前一句话的形式，而要根据事实来决定。但在译成汉语时，No 就要译成肯定的意思，如："是的，他不想离开。"
